messages:
Lena (Hiring): Sofia accepted the offer and is on H4 EAD that expires Jul 15. She asked if we can start her remote from Spain before renewal completes. Need quick guidance.
Marta (People Ops): Short: EAD expiration means no authorized US employment after expiry. If shes outside US, she can work remotely abroad, but we can't have her on US payroll while EAD is expired. Need to choose EOR/contractor or delay US payroll.
Sofia (Candidate): Im happy to start remotely from Spain and continue with the team. I prefer payroll if possible, but I understand constraints.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Immigration note: H4 EAD must be valid for any US employment. Working remotely from Spain while EAD expired is allowed but has tax implications. If she works as a US W-2 employee while physically in Spain, Redwood may have local employer obligations. Recommend EOR or contractor until EAD renewal card issued and shes physically in US. Also recommend we avoid any backdating of employment that implies work occurred under lapsed authorization.
Owen (Payroll): Operational: we cannot place Sofia on US payroll without a valid EAD or other authorization. EOR is feasible for Spain; contractor arrangement also possible but no benefits. If EAD renews and she enters US, we can onboard to US payroll and do retro pay if necessary (must document). Need bank/tax docs and local ID for EOR.
Marta (People Ops): Proposed plan: 1) Offer EOR for interim (we cover fees for first month) so she can be paid and onboarded. 2) Provide limited access to non-sensitive systems until payroll/onboarding complete. 3) Once EAD arrives and she is in US, transition to US payroll and benefits with a clear vesting/leave record.
Sofia (Candidate): EOR sounds good. Can you share what benefits Id lose in interim?
Marta (People Ops): Under EOR you wont have US health/401k. We can provide pro-rated equity onboarding guidance and continued note on PTO accruals to carry over post-transition. Well document everything.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Also advise Sofia to avoid entering US on the basis of EAD renewal receipt alone; she needs actual valid card to work in US. Provide advisory note about travel and entry timing.
hr-bot: Tagging candidate file: "h4-ead-renewal-eor" and setting follow-up: 10 days before EAD expiry.
Lena (Hiring): Thanks team. Sofia, welcome — we'll DM EOR paperwork and next steps.
Sofia (Candidate): Thanks all  please send the forms and any doc checklist. Appreciate the support.
